timing.note: Never discharges: the voltage does not drop over time (set the voltage prop to simulate a drained pack).

analog.note: Thevenin model: open-circuit voltage + internal resistance (alkaline AA 0.15 Ω/cell, NiMH 0.03 Ω/cell, LiPo 0.02 Ω/cell, 9 V block 1.7 Ω), so it sags under motor load. No polarization, temperature or state-of-charge curve.

power.note: Warns above the pack's practical current (AA 2 A, NiMH 5 A, LiPo 20 A, 9 V 0.5 A). No capacity (mAh) accounting.

testOnRealDevice: Brown-out of the Arduino when motors start on a shared pack
Never discharge a LiPo below 3.0 V per cell
